map.算法：BMI = 体重(kg) ÷ 身高(m)²；中国成人标准：<18.5 偏瘦: Algorithm: BMI = weight (kg) ÷ height (m)²; Chinese adult standard: <18.5 underweight, 18.5-24 normal, 24-28 overweight, ≥28 obese. Height and weight must be >0.
map.例1（65kg / 170cm）：BMI = 65 ÷ 1.7² = 65 ÷: Example 1 (65 kg / 170 cm): BMI = 65 ÷ 1.7² = 65 ÷ 2.89 = 22.5 → normal. Example 2 (80 kg / 175 cm): BMI = 80 ÷ 1.75² = 80 ÷ 3.0625 = 26.1 → overweight.
